forensic_summary: TRIGGER: 6/7 units suffered cosmetic coating failure and label peeling. INTERVENTION: Redesigned labels to eliminate stress concentrations and enforced VDI-15 matte finish standards. RESULT: Achieved launch readiness with recovered yield and defect-free cosmetic surfaces.

war_stories.label: Cosmetic Crisis
war_stories.description: Recovered from 6/7 cosmetic failure rate (coating peel) to launch readiness.
